critical_code_review_comments: Root cause of the preview outage was Metro's DiskCacheManager choking on a stale binary cache with a version mismatch ('Unable to deserialize cloned data due to invalid or unsupported version'). Metro logs it as a warning and 'falls back to a full crawl' — but combined with fast-resolver enabled and a busy watchman, the bundler was stuck rebuilding endlessly and never served /. The current logs still show the same deserialize warning on the newest supervisor start (see /var/log/supervisor/expo.err.log), yet the bundle is now served successfully (7.4MB, 200 OK), so the fallback crawl completes. To prevent recurrence, consider pinning METRO_CACHE_ROOT to a stable dir that is wiped on supervisor start, or clearing metro-file-map cache in a preStart hook.
Onboarding renders in Italian correctly; the probe I wrote was too strict (missed the \n) — not an app bug.

rca_of_issue: REPORTED BUG 'non mi carica la preview' — CONFIRMED FIXED. Root cause: Metro's disk file-map cache under METRO_CACHE_ROOT/tmp haste caches was written by a previous Metro version and could not be deserialized by the current one (v8 deserialize 'invalid or unsupported version'). Fix applied by main agent (stop expo → wipe /app/frontend/.metro-cache + /tmp/metro-* + /tmp/haste-* + /tmp/react-* → restart expo) rebuilds the cache from scratch. Verified: preview HTTP 200, bundle 7,414,844 bytes served, onboarding + full booking happy path completes to post-call review with zero blocking errors. Mitigation for recurrence: wire a preStart script for the expo supervisor program to `rm -rf` metro cache dirs so a stale cache from a prior image never blocks first boot.
